sections.heading: Repair, Camera Inspection, Drain Cleaning and Unclogging
body: We do sewer repair and camera inspections, and drain cleaning and unclogging. Residential drain cleaning carries a six-month guarantee, and residential plumbing work a one-year guarantee.
A camera on a flexible cable goes down the line, so you can see a break, roots or a sag that holds water before anyone digs. That picture is what separates clearing a clog from repairing a line.

image.alt: Floor drain in a basement utility room

sections.heading: Clog or Broken Line? How to Tell
body: A clog is something in the pipe, like grease, paper or roots, and a cable can clear it. A broken or collapsed line is the pipe itself failing, and clearing it only buys time.
Signs of the second: backups that keep coming back, more than one drain acting up at once, and soggy ground over the line.
Roots get in through the smallest crack in an older line, and once they do, the clogs come back faster each time.

sections.heading: A House Bought, Every Drain Replaced

sections.heading: What a Cleanout Does for the Next Backup
body: A cleanout is a capped opening on the sewer line that lets a plumber reach the pipe directly. The line can be cleared or inspected through it without pulling a toilet.
If a house doesn't have one, that's worth asking about when a backup has you on the phone.
